meta.parties: Mudianse Et Al. v. Sellandyar Et Al

rules.statement: A lessee can claim compensation for improvements made on leased land, even if the lease was not registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "The remedy is a purely equitable one, and it has been held by this Court in the case of Muttiah v. Clements 2 that a lessee can, in certain circumstances, claim compensation for improvements."
